vulnerabilities.title: ACTION_SEND Zip Slip overwrites files outside the import directory
vulnerabilities.harm: A provider-controlled ZIP entry containing ../ is joined directly to filesDir and can overwrite another private application path without canonical containment.

vulnerabilities.title: Exported dynamic receiver returns the session token to an attacker callback
vulnerabilities.harm: After the launcher registers a RECEIVER_EXPORTED callback without permission, an ordinary app sends the public action and receives account credentials through its PendingIntent.

vulnerabilities.title: Unauthenticated localhost TCP service discloses account credentials
vulnerabilities.harm: Any ordinary app with INTERNET permission connects to 127.0.0.1:48765 and obtains the target account and session token using GET_SESSION.

vulnerabilities.title: Attacker-controlled WebView content invokes an account JavaScript bridge
vulnerabilities.harm: An external deep-link URL is loaded with JavaScript and universal file access enabled, and the page can read the current account token through AccountBridge.getSessionToken.

vulnerabilities.title: Exported Binder service returns an account session bundle without caller validation
vulnerabilities.harm: An ordinary app binds to the exported service, sends transaction 7 with get_session_bundle, and receives status, account, token, and expiry fields.
